sections.body: These Terms & Conditions apply to Sekhon Indian Air Force Marathon 2026, scheduled for 4 October 2026 at Air Force Station Suratgarh.

sections.heading: 1. Event Registration
sections.body: This public website is an information and registration-guidance page. Registration must be completed through the official AFNET process from an AFNET-connected system. This website does not accept registration forms or create participant accounts.

sections.heading: 2. Registration Fees
sections.body: The Suratgarh registration fees are 5 KM: ₹200; 10 KM: ₹250; 21 KM: ₹250. Complete the official AFNET form and pay through the SI POS machine at Sports Section.

sections.heading: 3. Registration Deadline
sections.body: Registrations are scheduled to close on 27 September 2026. Registration may also close earlier if participant capacity is reached.

sections.heading: 4. Participant Information
sections.body: Ensure that the information entered in the official AFNET registration process is complete and accurate. The official registration process retains the participant information required for event administration.

sections.heading: 5. Race Categories
sections.body: Participants must take part only in the category for which they are officially registered. Requests for category changes are subject to organiser approval and availability.

sections.heading: 6. Race Timing and Results
sections.body: Race timing, results and completion records will be managed through official event arrangements. Organiser-recorded results will govern any competitive recognition.

sections.heading: 7. Race Day Benefits
sections.body: All registered participants will receive an event T-shirt and medal. T-shirt collection is on 3 October 2026, from 09:00 to 13:30, in front of SBI Bank inside the station. Food, refreshments and digital certificates are subject to confirmed event arrangements and completion rules.

sections.heading: 8. Participant Fitness & Safety
sections.body: Every participant is responsible for assessing their own physical fitness and ability to participate. Participants should seek appropriate medical advice before participating if they have health concerns. All participants must follow instructions issued by event officials, security personnel, medical teams and race marshals.

sections.heading: 9. Event Changes
sections.body: The organisers may modify race timings, routes, reporting instructions, event arrangements or other operational details when required due to safety, security, weather, government directions or circumstances beyond reasonable control.

sections.heading: 10. Conduct
sections.body: Participants are expected to maintain appropriate behaviour and comply with all event and venue rules. The organisers may refuse participation or disqualify a participant for unsafe, disruptive or inappropriate conduct.

sections.heading: 11. Photography & Event Media
sections.body: Photographs and videos may be captured during the event for event documentation, promotion and related communication. Any use of participant images will be handled in accordance with applicable law.

sections.heading: 12. Payments
sections.body: This public website does not process payments. The current payment method is the SI POS machine at Sports Section. Any authorised future payment method will be announced through official event channels.

sections.heading: 13. Refunds & Cancellations
sections.body: Refund and cancellation requests will be governed by the official event instructions and the Refund & Cancellation Policy.

sections.heading: 14. Privacy
sections.body: This public website does not collect participant registration or payment information. Information submitted through the official AFNET registration process is handled through that official process.

sections.heading: Suratgarh contact
sections.body: For Suratgarh event or registration assistance, contact the organising team on +91 8838463776 or +91 7027964880.
This Privacy Policy explains the limited role of the Sekhon Indian Air Force Marathon 2026 public information website.

sections.heading: 1. Public Website
sections.body: This website does not ask for, collect or store participant registration details, payment details, payment screenshots, transaction references or login credentials. It does not provide a participant sign-in or a public registration form.

sections.heading: 2. Official Registration
sections.body: Registration is completed through the official AFNET process from an AFNET-connected system. Participant information supplied there is retained and used through the official registration process for event administration.

sections.heading: 3. Payments
sections.body: The public website does not process payments. The current payment method is the SI POS machine at Sports Section; payment confirmation is handled through the official registration process.

sections.heading: 4. How Official Registration Information Is Used
sections.body: Information supplied through the official registration process may be used for registration administration, participant communication, race-category management, T-shirt planning, safety arrangements, results and eligible event benefits.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing of Information
sections.body: Participant information from the official registration process may be accessed by authorised event personnel only when reasonably necessary to organise and administer the event. It is not sold for commercial use.

sections.heading: 6. Data Security and Retention
sections.body: Information submitted through the official registration process is handled according to the applicable official procedures and record-keeping requirements.

sections.heading: 7. Website Technical Information
sections.body: This static public website does not use participant registration cookies or tracking to identify participants. Its hosting provider may process basic technical request information under that provider's own terms.

sections.heading: 8. Corrections and Questions
sections.body: For correction of official registration information or privacy questions, contact the organising team through the details below and follow the official registration process.

sections.heading: 9. Children's Information
sections.body: Where registration of a minor is permitted, registration should be completed with the involvement and consent of a parent or legal guardian as applicable.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: This Privacy Policy may be updated when official event arrangements change. The latest version published on this website will apply.

sections.heading: Suratgarh contact
sections.body: For Suratgarh event, registration or privacy assistance, contact the organising team on +91 8838463776 or +91 7027964880.
This Refund & Cancellation Policy applies to registrations made for Sekhon Indian Air Force Marathon 2026 through the official AFNET process.

sections.heading: 1. Registration Fees
sections.body: Registration fees are 5 KM – ₹200; 10 KM – ₹250; 21 KM – ₹250. Complete the official AFNET form and pay through the SI POS machine at Sports Section.

sections.heading: 2. Participant Cancellation
sections.body: Once a registration has been successfully completed and confirmed, the registration fee is generally non-refundable. Refunds will not normally be provided for a change of mind after registration, failure to attend the event, personal scheduling conflicts, travel-related issues, failure to complete the race, or disqualification due to a violation of event rules.

sections.heading: 3. Duplicate or Incorrect POS Payment
sections.body: If a duplicate or incorrect payment is made at the SI POS machine, contact Sports Section promptly and retain the official POS receipt for verification. Any correction or refund is subject to organiser verification and approval.

sections.heading: 4. Registration and Payment Discrepancy
sections.body: If payment has been made but the official AFNET registration process does not reflect the required confirmation, contact Sports Section or the organising team and follow the official correction procedure.

sections.heading: 5. Event Cancellation
sections.body: If the event is cancelled by the organisers and no alternative event arrangement is provided, any refund decision will be communicated through an official cancellation announcement.

sections.heading: 6. Event Rescheduling
sections.body: If the event is rescheduled, existing registrations may be transferred to the revised event date. Any refund option, where applicable, will be communicated by the organisers.

sections.heading: 7. Changes Due to Safety or Unavoidable Circumstances
sections.body: Race routes, timings or event arrangements may be changed because of weather, safety concerns, security requirements, government directions or circumstances beyond reasonable control. Such operational changes do not automatically create an entitlement to a refund.

sections.heading: 8. Refund Decisions
sections.body: Where a refund is approved, the organisers will communicate the applicable process and timing directly through official channels. This public website does not process refunds.

sections.heading: 9. How to Request a Refund
sections.body: For an eligible refund request, contact the organising team or Sports Section and follow the official instructions.

sections.heading: Suratgarh contact
sections.body: For Suratgarh event, registration or privacy assistance, contact the organising team on +91 8838463776 or +91 7027964880.
